messages:
Aisha: Heads up — noticed a 22% dip in inbound leads from the paid webinar cohort overnight. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/leadflow?view=paid-webinar :thinking_face:
Tom: Seen. Which KPI moved — MQLs or raw leads?
Aisha: Raw leads down, MQLs steady. Quick debug query -> ```SELECT source, COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE received_at >= '2026-03-18' GROUP BY source;``` returns paid_webinar: 48 yesterday vs 62 prior day
Miguel: Could be an attribution window shift or UTM mismatch. We rolled a new creative last week — did routing change? @jordana?
Jordana: I rolled changes to lead-mapper on Wed — added utm_content parsing for campaign=launch-x. I didn't touch the source field. I'll check mapper logs now.
pulsebot: Alert: lead-mapper error spike detected 2026-03-19 03:10 UTC (15 errors) :warning:
Tom: That spike aligns with the drop. Maybe upstream event schema changed and some leads failed to map to paid_webinar.
Aisha: Can someone run a crosswalk between raw click events and mapped leads for the last 72h? If UTM's missing we should trigger fallback mapping.
Miguel: On it. Pulling click events and mapping table — ETA 20m.
Miguel: Quick find — clicks still include utm_campaign=launch-x but some partners moved utm_content into a query param named `ct`. Our mapper only reads `utm_content`.
Jordana: Ugh. Will patch mapper to also read `ct` and fallback to referer parsing. Deploying a hotfix to staging then prod if smoke looks good.
Tom: Also please add an 'unattributed' breakout on the dashboard — 'other' hides when one named channel degrades.
Aisha: Agree. We'll flag this in the KPI review notes so leadership knows it's attribution noise, not funnel leakage.
Jordana: Hotfix deployed to prod at 1943217000. Running 10m smoke tests — no new errors so far.
Miguel: Rerun counts — paid_webinar returns ~60 in the last 2h, looks recovered. Patch seems to have fixed mapping.
Aisha: Great. Next steps: 1) dashboard change to surface unattributed trend, 2) update UTMs spec and share with partners, 3) add alert: mapper error rate >1%/hour.
Tom: I can take dashboard card + alert. Jordana — can you open PR updating the UTMs spec and ping partner-owners? Miguel — can you capture rollback and query snippets for the postmortem?
Jordana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/lead-mapper/pull/321 — includes ct fallback and tests. :shipit:
Aisha: Perfect. We'll call this out in Monday's KPI review — note: short-term attribution noise, not sustained funnel degradation. Thanks everyone.
Tom: :thumbsup:
pulsebot: Incident closed — lead-mapper errors resolved (ticket #1234).
